description: This Java source file defines the main activity class for an Android application that displays GPS tracks on a map. It manages map initialization, date selection, and loading/displaying GPS data points for a specific date, along with handling asynchronous data retrieval.
external_files: R (resources such as layouts and strings)

classes.name: PhoneMainActivity
classes.description: Main activity for the device's GPS tracking display, handling map setup, date selection, and tracking visualization.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and prepares the map fragment.

methods.name: onClick
methods.description: Launches a date picker dialog when a UI element is clicked.

methods.name: onDateSet
methods.description: Handles the date selected by the user, initiates loading of GPS track data for that date.

methods.name: showTrack
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves GPS points for a specific date and displays the route on the map.

methods.name: onMapReady
methods.description: Callback triggered when the map is ready to be used, assigns the map instance.
